include_domains.note: Same meaning as the shared include_domains (up to 500); not mapped yet.

exclude_domains.note: Same meaning as the shared exclude_domains; not mapped yet. Cannot be combined with include_domains.

boost_domains.note: Ranks these domains higher without filtering; cannot be combined with include_domains.

country.note: Uppercase ISO 3166 code from a fixed list; a candidate for the shared country option.

language.note: Uppercase language code from a fixed list (EN, EN-GB, ZH-HANS ...); a candidate for the shared locale option.

freshness.note: day | week | month | year, or a YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD range.

knowledge.note: core; knowledge results stay in raw.

strict_operators.note: Boolean; enforces quoted phrases and site: exactly. No effect with highlights.

crawl_timeout.note: 1-60 seconds; full_page extraction only (422 with highlights).

livecrawl.note: Deprecated in favour of extraction: web | all.

livecrawl_formats.note: Deprecated in favour of extraction.full_page.extraction_formats: html | markdown.
